summary: Three closures today: AMD long hit Target 1 intraday at $510.21 (+5.4%); RKLB short stopped out at $143.20 (−9.7%) after an $816M SDA government contract triggered the stated invalidation condition; MSFT/META pair stopped out as META surged +3.8% to $635.36, widening the pair spread −6.5% past the 5% threshold. Three new ideas added: Long DELL ($318.80, AI server earnings tonight — conditional May 29 entry), Long PLTR ($132.51, government AI + Iran military exchange premium), Long UUP ($27.70, safe-haven dollar on PCE ~3.3% core + Iran fabricated-deal escalation); NVDA held above the adjusted $210 stop at $211.34 close; SPX finished essentially flat at ~7,520.

closed_today.note: AMD hit $510.21 intraday (new 52-week high), clearing Target 1 at $500. Entry ~$470 on May 26; final close $495.54. SNOW's $6B AWS AI deal and NVDA's $91B Q2 guide read-through drove the AI GPU second-source thesis to fruition faster than the 4–8 week horizon.

Rocket Lab awarded $816M Space Development Agency Tracking Layer Tranche 3 contract on May 27, directly triggering the invalidation condition ('material new government contract'). Combined with prior $515M SDA award, RKLB's backlog exceeded $1.3B, undermining the space-scarcity-premium drain thesis. Closed at $143.20, above the $140 stop. Short entered at ~$130.50.

META +3.8% to $635.36 on AI advertising tailwinds and SNOW earnings validation; MSFT −0.8% to $412.65. MSFT/META ratio moved from ~0.694 at entry to ~0.650, a 6.5% adverse spread move exceeding the 5% pair stop threshold. Combined pair P&L approximately −3.4% of total notional.
